manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the hamburg with white sides and the Red carton box fries crispy golden and place them on the medium green tray for carrying.

Task description: Place the burger with white sides on the left and the golden fries in the red carton on the right onto the green tray in the middle, moving the fries with their carton. Each item has a target tray position, but the materials do not specify the exact locations.

Success criteria: The hamburger and red fries box are both on the green tray, each horizontally near its corresponding target position; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Grasp wider, uniformly thick areas on both sides of the burger, avoiding protruding thin edges. Confirm the fingers surround the object before closing to reduce pushing and slipping from an off-center grasp.
- The red fries carton is only partly visible at the right edge of the main view. Confirm its outline using live observations, then grasp intact opposing sides below its opening, avoiding exposed fries and leaving fingertip clearance above the table.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the actual grasp width. Keep the fries box opening facing up during transport to reduce brushing nearby objects and spilling the fries.
- When moving into the tray, keep the object bottom above the raised rim first and leave room for the other object and gripper opening to avoid hitting the rim or pushing either object.
- During release, first let the object's base rest on the tray surface, then open the gripper and withdraw through a clear path. Avoid releasing it unsupported or moving it during withdrawal.
